viewing_check: Check the back for printer label (Lynch/Jansen), condition of the print surface (tears, lifted canvas texture, foxing), and frame damage. Genuine vintage prints in good condition sold $400-660 over the last 2 years (7 sales Oct 2024-Mar 2026), rising slightly; the Mar 2026 sale was $470. Estimate 100-150, bid $55. Needs careful packing for post.
